描述_EN: this figure of a warrior was placed inside the tomb to ward off evil spirits. chinese grave goods in ancient times included replicas of men and women engaged in work or leisurely recreations, made from pottery but in reduced size.
描述_ZN: 这个武士的形象被放置在墓穴内，以驱除邪恶的精神。 中国古代的墓葬物品包括从事工作或休闲娱乐的男人和女人的复制品，由陶器制成，但尺寸缩小。
